description: Ask how the user would want an action handled, before you take it on their behalf — without reading their profile. Call it BEFORE any consequential action you are about to take for the user: merging or deploying, publishing or posting, sending a message, paying or committing money, deleting, or changing an account or setting. Describe the action in action_descriptor (domain, reversible, magnitude, a short summary; amount when money moves) and bind it to the exact call with action_binding. Returns a signal (proceed | proceed_with_note | clarify | escalate | decline | insufficient_signal), a confidence, a short rationale_hint, a deference_level (how strongly to weight it) and a receipt_id. Keep the receipt_id: when the user reacts to what you did — confirms it, overrides it, or wants it done differently — record that with phaedo_record_outcome.

action_binding.description: Binds this consultation to the concrete call it describes. The action_descriptor is your ACCOUNT of the action; this is the action. Recorded on the audit receipt so a later mismatch is provable, shown to the user when an escalation reaches their phone, and REQUIRED by any standing rule the user marked require_binding before it will auto-proceed.

arguments_hash.description: Hex or base64url digest over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the arguments. Never the arguments themselves.

arguments_preview.description: Optional short human-readable summary of the arguments, shown to the subject on an escalation.

tool_name.description: The tool/function the agent is about to invoke.

name: phaedo_consult
title: Consult the Phaedo fingerprint at a decision point
